summary: Adds a thumbnail helper that runs ImageMagick convert on an uploaded file, a docs URL setting, and a /calc endpoint that evaluates an arithmetic expression from the query string.

findings.title: Request query string run through eval
findings.problem: The /calc handler passes req.query.expr straight to eval. The added comments switch off the linters that would report this.
findings.consequence: Any caller can run arbitrary JavaScript on the server, such as require('child_process').execSync(...). That gives full remote code execution.
findings.fix: Remove eval and parse the expression with a restricted arithmetic evaluator such as expr-eval. Reject any input that fails to parse.

findings.title: Upload name interpolated into a shell command
findings.problem: make_thumbnail puts upload_name from the upload form into a shell command string run with shell=True. The docstring says the name comes from the upload form.
findings.consequence: An uploader can choose a name like 'x; rm -rf ~' and run any shell command. A name with '../' also reads or writes outside the upload and thumbnail folders.
findings.fix: Pass convert an argument list without shell=True. Reject names that differ from their os.path.basename.

findings.title: New behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds make_thumbnail and the /calc endpoint. No test exercises either one.
findings.consequence: Regressions in input handling for both entry points will go unnoticed. That includes the injection cases.
findings.fix: Add tests that call both entry points with normal input. Also cover hostile names and expressions.

dropped.reason: The noqa only allows a long documentation URL string. It hides no logic.
This suppression hides the same shell injection that the c1 finding raises. One finding covers the problem.
